comments.headline: Building elevations and sections missing; vertical clearances unverified
comments.summary: The site plan lacks building elevation sheets and section/profile views necessary to verify vertical clearances from surveyed overhead conductor elevations to buildings and their projections. This documentation is required by code when buildings are within clearance distance of overhead facilities.
comments.attn: Applicant must hire registered professional surveyor to provide measured pole and conductor elevation data.

comments.headline: Clearance dimensions and measurement methodology not documented on plans
comments.summary: No clearance dimensions are shown on any site plan sheets demonstrating measurements from the outside conductor to buildings, structures, driveways, or other site features. The measurement standard (from outside conductor, not pole centerline) cannot be verified because no dimensions are present.
comments.attn: Dimension lines must originate at conductor location, not pole center. Multi-conductor installations have conductors offset several feet from pole center.

Measurement standard (from outside conductor, not pole centerline) cannot be verified because no dimensions are shown. Distance dimensions from buildings to property boundary (29.6', 45.9', 21.3') are not clearance dimensions from the overhead electric conductor.

runComments.comment: No clearance dimensions are provided on any site plan sheets showing measurements from the outside conductor (outermost electric line) to buildings, structures, walls, or other site features. Where clearance dimensions should be shown (such as on building elevation sheets or section views), none are present. The measurement standard (from outside conductor, not from pole centerline) cannot be verified because no dimensions are shown.

Critical requirement: all clearance dimensions must be measured from the OUTSIDE CONDUCTOR, never from utility pole centerline. Multi-conductor installations have conductors offset several feet from pole center. Currently, no clearance dimensions are shown on any plan sheets, so this measurement methodology cannot be verified. When clearance dimensions are provided, ensure dimension lines originate at the conductor location (not pole center) and extend to the outermost edge of the site feature being cleared.

The overhead conductor location is not dimensioned relative to these distance measurements.

comments.headline: Construction logistics plan and 48-hour notification requirement missing
comments.summary: No construction logistics plan, site logistics plan, or phasing plan submitted showing that construction staging areas, equipment zones, and work platforms maintain 10-foot radial working clearance from energized overhead electric lines per OSHA 1910.333 and UCM § 1.10.2. Additionally, required notice to owner/contractor regarding 48-hour notification to Austin Energy before work near high-voltage overhead lines (Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003) is not present on cover sheet or general notes.
comments.crossDep: Austin Energy pre-construction coordination; OSHA compliance oversight; contractor safety protocols.
comments.attn: Verify whether 48-hour transmission-specific note on Sheet 3 applies to distribution line. General notification requirement must appear on cover or general notes for entire site.

details.text: No construction logistics plan, site logistics plan, or construction phasing plan submitted mapping construction staging areas, equipment laydown zones, crane swing radius, or work platforms. Working clearance requirement (OSHA 1910.333, UCM § 1.10.2) cannot be verified: staging areas and equipment operation zones must maintain 10-foot radial clearance from energized overhead electric lines during all construction phases.

runComments.comment: No construction logistics plan, site logistics plan, or construction phasing plan is included in the submitted site plan set that maps construction staging areas, equipment laydown zones, crane swing radius, or work platforms. Without these plans showing staging area boundaries with 10-foot radial clearance from energized overhead lines maintained during construction, the working clearance requirement (OSHA 1910.333, UCM § 1.10.2) cannot be verified to be satisfied.

No construction phasing plan or logistics plan has been provided in the site plan package showing staging area boundaries and confirming 10-foot working clearance during all construction phases. Provide construction logistics plan or phasing plan showing staging areas and confirming 10-foot radial clearance from OHE during all construction phases.

This requirement applies during construction and is separate from permanent clearances. Contractor must maintain required clearances during construction near the overhead line at southern boundary.

The absence of this critical safety note from the plan set is non-compliant.

No general notification requirement for the overhead distribution line is provided on the cover sheet or general notes.

Four-inch minimum diameter galvanized rigid metal posts must be installed per AE Design equipment pad details referenced in UCM § 1.10.4 Table 1.10.4.
